I have implemented type-safe SQL window expressions and named `WINDOW` clause support in a new branch (`feat/window-functions`) from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Functions & Frame Builders ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts))**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L257-L259), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L261-L263), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L265-L267), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L269-L274), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L276-L278), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L280-L282).
   - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L284-L311), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L313-L340), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L342-L346), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L348-L352), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L354-L365), typed nullable by default with `null` stripped on `lag` and `lead` when a `defaultValue` is provided.
   - **Aggregate window helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L367-L369), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L371-L373), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L375-L382), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L384-L391), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L393-L398) (emitting `count(*)` when called without arguments).
   - **Frame utilities & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L142-L145), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L147-L150), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L63), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L64), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L65), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L67-L72), and [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L74-L79).
   - **Exports**: Re-exported from [src/sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) so all symbols are available from the top-level package.

2. **Named Windows & `.window(name, spec)` Across Dialects**:
   - Added `.window(name, spec)` and `WINDOW` clause compilation before `ORDER BY` across PostgreSQL ([pg-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts), [pg-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts)), MySQL ([mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts), [mysql-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts)), SQLite ([sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts), [sqlite-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts)), SingleStore ([singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts), [singlestore-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts)), and Gel ([gel-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts), [gel-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts)).

3. **Tests**:
   - Added runtime unit tests in [window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) and type tests in [window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ydgnfvew/drizzle-orm/type-tests/pg/window.ts).
